newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,060 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,060 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,060 contracts compared with 826 overnight Tuesday.
There were 187 wheat, 431 corn, 389 soybean, two soymeal, 15 soyoil, one corn call and 35 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to four cents lower, corn was steady to 3/4 cent lower and soybeans were 1/2 cent higher to 1/2 cent lower.
